utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what time does the repair drive start at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — once the tool list is in, I can swing by and help fill in whatever’s missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Mara — start at the first repair drive location and let me know what tools you need. I’ll bring whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not much yet — we’re still sorting the repair drive details. I’ll let you know as soon as the plan’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the urgent stuff is fine for me — gate and lane markers, if that’s the main list. What time do you want us there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the exact time, but I can check on that. Gate and lane markers sound like the main urgent items, so I’ll confirm the first location too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m checking what tools we’re still missing for the repair drive, and I’ll let you know as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we start at the community center on Maple, and then we can head over to the gate and those lane markers after. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good — I can do after lunch. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which parts still need repair for the drive? I want to check the details before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m still pulling together the full list, but I know we’re covering the usual small fixes and anything the tool list turns up. Once I have the details, I’ll send them over right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening — I’m just sorting what’s most urgent and when everyone should show up. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the plan nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know when the time’s set, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and connect folks who want to pitch in—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know which tools and parts we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — Sunday at the community center still works for me. Just send the list when you have it, and I’ll keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The first repair drive spot is still the community center on Maple, and I’ll keep an eye out for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the community center on Maple — thanks, Opal. I’ll keep an eye out for the tool list and any updates.
